Revise C3 and C6 to accept the natural encoding the model produces: either (a) broaden the check to accept any assessment_method value containing both "portfolio" and "observed practical" (case-insensitive substring match), or (b) if C3/C6 expect a separate dedicated field (e.g., a boolean requires_observed_practical or an enum like "portfolio+practical"), add that field to the settlement schema and map it from the existing assessment_method value. No changes are needed to shared_context, agent personalities, or the reveal norms — disclosure and provenance are working correctly across all rollouts.
